title: Yellow Mech Punk Poses
description: Four sequential poses of a young male character with spiky blonde hair wearing a black and yellow armored outfit with mechanical knee and shoulder pads. The character progresses from a fighting stance with fists raised, through a dynamic kick, to a final ready stance holding a small dark object.
prompt: A young male fighter with spiky blonde hair and determined expression, wearing black tactical pants and a yellow and black armored vest with large mechanical shoulder and knee pads, shown in four sequential action poses against a dark gray background. First pose is a ready fighting stance with fists up, second shows a high kick with leg extended, third is a powerful striking pose, fourth shows him standing ready holding a small device. Stylized 3D character render with strong lighting and detailed textures.
